comparisons.reason: Different constructs. Feature 0 is 1 when some comment rebuts the OP mainly through abstract logical reasoning and contains no named real-world example or analogy. This is a rebuttal-style construct defined by the absence of examples. Feature 1 is 1 when some comment introduces a concrete external real-world analogy, and it has no requirement to rebut. They are not the same predicate, and the spec for 0 says a row can be 1 on both. A single comment cannot satisfy both, but different comments can, so neither feature determines the other.
